name: dialog
blurb: Animated modal with fade-in overlay and slide-in content transitions.
description: A FramerModal component using Framer Motion; fades and slides in on open; closes on Escape or backdrop click; supports controlled/uncontrolled state.
use_when: Creating polished dialogs with smooth entrance/exit animations and responsive backdrop interactions.
avoid_when: For simple lightweight dialogs without animation — use shadcn Dialog instead to reduce bundle size.
a11y: Escape key closes the dialog; backdrop click closes it; body overflow prevented; focus is managed by AnimatePresence.
